name: Arthurs Seat Eagle
address: Arthur Seat Rd, Arthurs Seat VIC 3936
signature: The Peninsula's most iconic panoramic experience — a gondola ride over the hinterland with 360° views from bay to ocean
editorNote:
Arthurs Seat Eagle is the gondola that runs from the base of Arthurs Seat State Park to the summit at 305 metres — the highest point on the Peninsula — with views that sweep from Port Phillip Bay across the hinterland to Bass Strait on a clear day. It is one of the Peninsula's most visited attractions for good reason.

The gondolas run continuously and the ride takes about 15 minutes each way. At the summit there is a cafe, walking tracks through the state park, and the kind of view that makes you realise how much Peninsula there actually is.

Book ahead on weekends and in summer — queues can be long. The ride is genuinely impressive regardless of the season: autumn colour in the hinterland below, winter mist in the valleys, summer blue in every direction. Combine with the Enchanted Adventure Garden next door for families.
whyWeGo: The best single view on the Peninsula — a gondola ride to the top with bay and ocean visible simultaneously on a clear day.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book ahead and go on a clear day. The view is the whole point.
